raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The planner misinterpreted the comparison of death dates. Despite correctly gathering that Boris Barnet (Bountiful Summer) died on 8 Jan 1965 and Oldřich Lipský (Lemonade Joe) died on 19 Oct 1986, they concluded Lipský died earlier. This inversion error led to the wrong final answer; the correct earlier death is Barnet, so Bountiful Summer.
